# Fixture — archetype roster

Small, synthetic stand-in for `docs/design/content/archetypes.md`. The tests copy this tree and
mutate it, so the shapes here (a roster name column, a naming appendix without slugs) are the
shapes the checker has to read.

| slug | name | one-line identity | level band | hostile? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `giant-rat` | Giant Rat † | Eats the spilled grain. | 1–3 | yes |
| `drove-cur` | Drove Cur | Feral dog of the dry-stone walls. | 1–3 | yes |

## Naming — derivation notes

| name | derivation |
|---|---|
| Drove Cur | Common: *drove* + *cur*, a working dog |
| Peat Adder | Common: *peat* + *adder* |
